items.question: Which additional mantric syllables are addressed to the infinite power?
premises: The verse lists the syllables śrīṃ, paraśuṃ, ca, ṅentaṃ, huṃ, and phaṭ.
The word tathā marks these as a continued utterance.
The dative ananta-śaktaye specifies infinite power as the addressee.
items.inference: The sequence of mantric syllables is transmitted as addressed to the infinite power.
uncertainties: The precise referent and analysis of ṅentaṃ are unclear.
items.plain_english: Likewise, the syllables śrīṃ, paraśuṃ, ṅentaṃ, huṃ, and phaṭ are uttered to the infinite power.
